units.rainfall_slope_per_100_mm: NDVI per 100 mm, [estimate, lower, upper], 95% interval
units.residual_trend_per_decade: NDVI per decade, [estimate, lower, upper], 95% t interval
units.autocorrelation_adjusted_per_decade: NDVI per decade, [lower, upper], effective sample size interval
units.theil_sen_per_decade: NDVI per decade, [estimate, lower, upper], Sen's 95% interval

status_meanings.computed: rainfall slope interval entirely above zero; the residual trend is rainfall-adjusted
status_meanings.precondition_not_met: rainfall slope interval not entirely above zero; the residual trend is stored but is not described as rainfall-adjusted
status_meanings.insufficient_seasons: fewer than 15 seasons with both values; no slope

direction_meanings.includes_zero: interval includes zero; no direction is stated

windows.rationale: Fixed by the science lane on 2026-10-28 before any MODIS NDVI value was summarized. March to June spans spring green-up from the valley floor (about 1500 to 2300 m) to the upper slopes, where the 2001 to 2013 MODIS record of Atlas catchments shows snow persisting into spring (SCI-26); March to May and April to July are the earlier and later sensitivity windows for the low and high bands. September to May is the hydrological year up to the end of the main window; November to April is the wet season of the registered season_summary recipe. The lane had not read the Sentinel-2 monthly series values of this valley; that series (2019 to 2025) was built and inspected by another lane of the project.

limitations: The rainfall-adjusted residual still holds everything else that changes greenness: temperature, snow, irrigation, orchards and fields, grazing, fire, and sensor or orbit changes. It is not a measure of grazing impact or of degradation.

Trend methods can miss real change: in simulations for southern Africa, 30 to 40% degradation was needed before a trend showed under a rainfall-driven increase, and the residual method broke down at about 20% degradation (Wessels et al. 2012). An interval that includes zero is not evidence of no change.
Each 250 m MODIS pixel mixes surfaces; stratum values weight pixels by how much of the stratum falls inside them, so a mixed pixel counts toward more than one stratum.
Rainfall comes from 5 km CHIRPS grid cells, not from gauges in the valley, and snowfall is counted with rain.
Each stratum and window pair has its own interval. With many shown together, some intervals will exclude zero by chance alone.

Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020, from 10:30 to about 9:06 mean local time by December 2025 (NASA): later seasons are seen with a lower sun and longer shadows in mountain terrain, which may shift NDVI without any change on the ground.
The windows were fixed before the MODIS values were read; other windows can give other slopes, which is why all registered windows are stored together.
